entries.title: Blessing Aura
entries.body:
# Blessing Aura

## Overview
Through unwavering faith, you become a living conduit for your patron's divine presence. Rather than calling upon a single miracle, you invite a fragment of your deity's essence into the mortal world, surrounding yourself with a sacred aura that reflects their domains and ideals.

No two Blessing Auras are ever the same. A Cleric devoted to a god of life may radiate gentle warmth and flourishing vitality, while a servant of death may be cloaked in silent shadows and drifting souls. Patrons of fate may weave shimmering threads through the air, whereas patrons of war may surround their followers with the echoes of distant battle.

At this rank, your connection is still developing, allowing only a small manifestation of your patron's power. Even so, those who stand within the aura quickly realise they are no longer standing beside a mere mortal, but within the presence of something far greater.

## Rank 1
### Description

Through unwavering faith, you become a living conduit for your patron's divine presence. Rather than calling upon a single miracle, you invite a fragment of your deity's essence into the mortal world, surrounding yourself with a sacred aura that reflects their domains and ideals.

No two Blessing Auras are ever the same. A Cleric devoted to a god of life may radiate gentle warmth and flourishing vitality, while a servant of death may be cloaked in silent shadows and drifting souls. Patrons of fate may weave shimmering threads through the air, whereas patrons of war may surround their followers with the echoes of distant battle.

At this rank, your connection is still developing, allowing only a small manifestation of your patron's power. Even so, those who stand within the aura quickly realise they are no longer standing beside a mere mortal, but within the presence of something far greater.

### Effects

- As an Action, expend **20 MP** to manifest your **Blessing Aura**.
- Your Blessing Aura is centred on you and moves with you.
- The aura has a **5 metre radius**.
- The aura lasts for **2 rounds**.
- Allies and enemies are immediately affected upon entering the aura and cease being affected when they leave it.
- The effects of the Blessing Aura are **entirely determined by your chosen patron**.
- Blessing Aura has no innate effects of its own and instead acts as the vessel through which your patron's divine influence is expressed.
- If multiple Blessing Auras overlap, a creature can only be affected by one Blessing Aura at a time. If a conflict occurs, the GM determines which aura takes precedence.
- Blessing Aura is considered **Divine Magic**.

### Lore

The oldest temples teach that a Cleric does not command divine power—they are entrusted with it. Blessing Aura is often the first miracle granted to newly ordained priests, marking the moment their patron acknowledges them as a worthy vessel.

Many theologians believe every Blessing Aura is unique, carrying subtle signs of the deity behind it. Some are unmistakable, while others are understood only by devoted followers. To those who witness them, these manifestations are reminders that the gods are never truly absent from the world.

As a Cleric's faith deepens, so too does the strength of their Blessing Aura. What begins as a faint divine presence may one day become a manifestation so overwhelming that entire battlefields are transformed by the will of a single god.

> *"Do not mistake the aura for the miracle. The aura is merely the doorway through which the divine chooses to enter our world."*
>
> — High Hierophant Elaris, Keeper of the Sacred Testament

## Rank 2
### Description

Your bond with your patron grows stronger, allowing their divine presence to linger longer and reach farther across the battlefield. What was once a faint manifestation now becomes an unmistakable symbol of your deity's influence, inspiring both reverence and caution from those who witness it.

As your faith deepens, your patron entrusts you with a greater measure of their power. The aura expands naturally around you, extending its influence over more allies and enemies alike. Every step you take carries your patron's presence, making you the centre of a moving sanctuary—or a warning to those who oppose your deity.

Although every Blessing Aura remains unique to the patron it represents, all share one truth: the faithful do not stand alone. Wherever a Cleric walks, the will of their deity walks with them.

### Effects

- As an Action, expend **25 MP** to manifest your **Blessing Aura**.
- Your Blessing Aura is centred on you and moves with you.
- The aura has a **7.5 metre radius**.
- The aura lasts for **3 rounds**.
- Allies and enemies are immediately affected upon entering the aura and cease being affected when they leave it.
- The effects of the Blessing Aura are **entirely determined by your chosen patron**.
- Blessing Aura has no innate effects of its own and instead serves as the vessel through which your patron expresses their divine influence.
- If multiple Blessing Auras overlap, a creature can only be affected by one Blessing Aura at a time. If a conflict occurs, the GM determines which aura takes precedence.
- Blessing Aura is considered **Divine Magic**.

### Lore

Senior priests often describe this stage of mastery as the moment a Cleric ceases to merely invoke their patron and instead begins to embody their presence. Those familiar with the signs of the gods can often identify a Cleric's patron long before a word is spoken, simply by observing the aura that surrounds them.

Across Asteria, temples preserve countless accounts of battlefields transformed by the arrival of a devoted Cleric. Soldiers speak of impossible courage, unnatural silence, blooming flowers, spectral ravens or radiant light appearing moments before the tide of battle changed. Whether these tales are miracles or legends is a matter of faith, but few deny the profound influence a true Blessing Aura can have.

> *"The faithful need not announce whom they serve. Their patron speaks through every step they take."*
>
> — Archbishop Maelor, Voice of the Divine Conclave

## Rank 3
### Description

Your unwavering devotion has strengthened the bond between yourself and your patron, allowing a greater portion of their divine presence to manifest within the mortal realm. Your Blessing Aura no longer feels like a fleeting miracle, but a sacred domain where your deity's influence is undeniable.

Those who enter the aura instinctively sense the presence of something beyond mortal understanding. To the faithful, it is a place of comfort, purpose or reassurance. To those who stand opposed to your patron's ideals, it may become a place of unease, judgement or overwhelming reverence. Every manifestation remains unique, shaped entirely by the deity who grants your power.

As your mastery grows, your Blessing Aura becomes a symbol recognised by clergy and scholars alike. It is no longer merely evidence of your faith—it is proof that your patron trusts you to carry a greater fragment of their divine will into the world.

### Effects

- As an Action, expend **30 MP** to manifest your **Blessing Aura**.
- Your Blessing Aura is centred on you and moves with you.
- The aura has a **10 metre radius**.
- The aura lasts for **4 rounds**.
- Allies and enemies are immediately affected upon entering the aura and cease being affected when they leave it.
- The effects of the Blessing Aura are **entirely determined by your chosen patron**.
- Blessing Aura has no innate effects of its own and instead serves as the vessel through which your patron expresses their divine influence.
- If multiple Blessing Auras overlap, a creature can only be affected by one Blessing Aura at a time. If a conflict occurs, the GM determines which aura takes precedence.
- Blessing Aura is considered **Divine Magic**.

### Lore

Within the great temples of Asteria, reaching this level of mastery is considered a significant milestone in a Cleric's journey. It marks the point where the faithful cease to simply invoke miracles and instead become recognised as enduring vessels of divine influence.

Some believe the gods themselves can perceive the world through these sacred manifestations, watching over their followers from beyond the veil. Whether this belief is truth or tradition, few can deny that those who stand within a powerful Blessing Aura often feel the unmistakable presence of something far greater than themselves.

The appearance of such an aura has become a symbol of hope, judgement or destiny throughout history, its meaning forever shaped by the patron whose power it carries.

> *"Faith is not measured by the prayers you offer, but by the presence your patron entrusts you to bear."*
>
> — Saint Aveline, First Oracle of the Divine Concord

## Rank 4
### Description

The divine presence surrounding you has become a beacon of your patron's authority. No longer a simple manifestation of faith, your Blessing Aura now establishes a sacred domain wherever you stand. Within its boundaries, the influence of your deity is undeniable, and those who enter it instinctively recognise they have crossed into ground touched by the divine.

Your patron's power flows effortlessly through you, requiring little conscious effort to maintain. Every movement extends their reach, every prayer strengthens their presence, and every ally standing beside you shares in the blessings your deity chooses to bestow. Likewise, those who oppose your patron cannot escape the consequences of entering their sacred domain.

Veteran Clerics are often identified long before they reveal themselves. Their Blessing Aura becomes synonymous with their reputation, leaving behind stories of miraculous salvation, unwavering courage, inevitable judgement or peaceful serenity—each one reflecting the ideals of the patron they faithfully serve.

### Effects

- As an Action, expend **35 MP** to manifest your **Blessing Aura**.
- Your Blessing Aura is centred on you and moves with you.
- The aura has a **12.5 metre radius**.
- The aura lasts for **5 rounds**.
- Allies and enemies are immediately affected upon entering the aura and cease being affected when they leave it.
- The effects of the Blessing Aura are **entirely determined by your chosen patron**.
- Blessing Aura has no innate effects of its own and instead serves as the vessel through which your patron expresses their divine influence.
- Your Blessing Aura is considered a **Sacred Domain** for the purpose of patron abilities and future Cleric talents.
- If multiple Blessing Auras overlap, a creature can only be affected by one Blessing Aura at a time. If a conflict occurs, the GM determines which aura takes precedence.
- Blessing Aura is considered **Divine Magic**.

### Lore

Only the most devoted servants are entrusted with carrying such a powerful manifestation of their patron's presence. Across Asteria, these Clerics are regarded not merely as priests but as living sanctuaries, capable of bringing a fragment of the divine into even the darkest corners of the world.

Pilgrims often travel great distances simply to witness a master Cleric invoke their Blessing Aura. Some seek healing, others guidance or judgement, while many come only to experience what it feels like to stand within the unmistakable presence of a god.

The oldest scriptures teach that the strength of a Blessing Aura is not measured by its brilliance or size, but by the depth of the bond between patron and servant. Those chosen to wield such power are forever changed, carrying a part of their deity wherever they walk.

> *"When the faithful gather around their Cleric, they do not stand beside a priest—they stand within the shadow of a god."*
>
> — Grand Hierophant Solenar, Keeper of the Eternal Sanctum

## Rank 5
### Description

Your faith has reached its pinnacle, allowing you to become a true vessel of your patron's divine presence. Your Blessing Aura no longer represents a fleeting miracle—it is a manifestation of your deity's will upon the mortal plane. Wherever you walk, the influence of your patron follows, transforming the battlefield into sacred ground shaped by their domains, ideals and purpose.

The aura itself is unique to every Cleric, reflecting the patron they serve. It may appear as radiant light, blooming life, drifting souls, roaring storms, flowing waters, shimmering threads of fate or countless other divine manifestations. Those who stand within its boundaries cannot mistake its origin, for the presence of a god is unmistakable.

To friend and foe alike, a master Cleric is more than a priest—they are the living embodiment of divine authority. Entire armies have rallied around such individuals, while others have abandoned the field rather than face the overwhelming presence of a deity made manifest through mortal hands.

### Effects

- As an Action, expend **40 MP** to manifest your **Blessing Aura**.
- Your Blessing Aura is centred on you and moves with you.
- The aura has a **15 metre radius**.
- The aura lasts for **10 rounds**.
- Allies and enemies are immediately affected upon entering the aura and cease being affected when they leave it.
- The effects of the Blessing Aura are **entirely determined by your chosen patron**.
- Blessing Aura has no innate effects of its own and instead serves as the vessel through which your patron expresses their divine influence.
- Your Blessing Aura is considered a **Sacred Domain** for the purpose of all Cleric talents, Patron abilities and divine effects.
- While your Blessing Aura is active, you are considered to be **Channeling your Patron**.
- If multiple Blessing Auras overlap, a creature can only be affected by one Blessing Aura at a time. If a conflict occurs, the GM determines which aura takes precedence.
- Blessing Aura is considered **Divine Magic**.

### Lore

Among the oldest religions of Asteria, only a handful of Clerics throughout history have achieved this level of communion with their patron. Such individuals are remembered not for the miracles they performed, but for the unmistakable presence they carried wherever they travelled. Entire cities would fall silent as they passed, sensing that the veil between the mortal and divine had grown impossibly thin.

Scholars often debate whether these legendary Clerics merely carried their patron's blessing or whether, for brief moments, the gods themselves looked upon the world through their faithful servant. Whatever the truth, every account speaks of the same feeling—a presence so overwhelming that it inspired hope, fear, peace or judgement before a single word was spoken.

To master Blessing Aura is to surrender completely to one's faith. The Cleric no longer calls upon the divine—they become the means through which the divine touches the world.

> *"The greatest miracle is not the power of the gods, but the mortal they trust to bear it."*
>
> — Saint Aurelius, First Voice of the Divine Conclave

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.body:
# Channel Divinity

## Overview
Your devotion has opened a permanent spiritual connection between yourself and your chosen patron. Divine power now flows through that bond, allowing your patron’s influence to shape your abilities, miracles and sacred presence.

Channel Divinity does not grant a universal effect of its own. Instead, it unlocks the Rank I Channel Divinity effects recorded on your patron’s page. These effects represent the unique blessings, restrictions and divine influence granted by the being you serve.

Some patrons may strengthen healing, protection or restoration, while others influence death, warfare, knowledge, nature or fate. Whatever form the connection takes, its power is determined entirely by the patron rather than by the Cleric talent itself.

## Rank 1
### Description

Your devotion has opened a permanent spiritual connection between yourself and your chosen patron. Divine power now flows through that bond, allowing your patron’s influence to shape your abilities, miracles and sacred presence.

Channel Divinity does not grant a universal effect of its own. Instead, it unlocks the Rank I Channel Divinity effects recorded on your patron’s page. These effects represent the unique blessings, restrictions and divine influence granted by the being you serve.

Some patrons may strengthen healing, protection or restoration, while others influence death, warfare, knowledge, nature or fate. Whatever form the connection takes, its power is determined entirely by the patron rather than by the Cleric talent itself.

### Effects

- Channel Divinity is a **passive talent** and requires no action or resource cost.
- Upon unlocking this talent, you gain access to the **Rank I Channel Divinity effects** listed on your chosen patron’s page.
- Channel Divinity has no universal mechanical effects of its own.
- All bonuses, penalties, triggers, restrictions and special abilities granted by Channel Divinity are determined entirely by the chosen patron.
- Patron effects granted through Channel Divinity remain active whenever their listed conditions are met.
- Channel Divinity effects may interact with Cleric talents, spells, Blessing Aura or other divine abilities when stated on the patron’s page.
- You cannot benefit from Channel Divinity effects belonging to more than one patron at the same time.
- Changing patrons removes the previous patron’s Channel Divinity effects and replaces them with those of the new patron once the change is accepted by the GM.
- Channel Divinity is considered a **Divine Patron connection** rather than a spell or activated ability.

### Lore

To the faithful, Channel Divinity marks the moment devotion becomes communion. The Cleric no longer reaches toward the divine through prayer alone; their patron has answered by forming a lasting bond through which sacred influence may pass.

This connection differs greatly between religions. Some Clerics feel their patron as warmth beneath the skin, a whisper behind every prayer or a presence that watches through their eyes. Others bear visible signs such as shifting runes, sacred markings, spectral light or changes in their voice when invoking divine authority.

The bond is not ownership, nor does it allow the Cleric to command their patron. It is an agreement of faith and purpose. The patron grants power, but also expects the Cleric to uphold the ideals through which that power was given.

> *“Prayer asks the divine to listen. Channeling begins when the divine answers.”*
>
> — The First Covenant of the Ordained

## Rank 2
### Description

Your spiritual bond with your patron deepens, allowing a greater portion of their divine essence to flow through you. The connection becomes steadier and more responsive, enabling your patron to bestow additional blessings upon those they deem worthy.

As your faith matures, your patron entrusts you with greater responsibilities and reveals more of their divine nature. Every miracle you perform, every blessing you grant and every prayer you answer becomes a reflection of their will. While all Clerics share the same path toward Channel Divinity, the power they ultimately wield remains unique to the deity they serve.

At this stage, your patron's influence extends beyond a single blessing, granting new manifestations that reinforce their domains and strengthen your identity as one of their chosen servants.

### Effects

- Channel Divinity remains a **passive talent**.
- You gain access to the **Rank II Channel Divinity effects** listed on your chosen patron's page.
- You retain all effects gained from **Channel Divinity – Rank I**.
- Channel Divinity has no universal mechanical effects of its own.
- All effects, triggers, bonuses, penalties and restrictions are determined entirely by your chosen patron.
- Patron effects may interact with your **Blessing Aura**, Cleric talents, spells and other divine abilities when specified on the patron's page.
- You cannot benefit from Channel Divinity effects belonging to more than one patron at the same time.
- If your patron changes, all previous Channel Divinity effects are lost and replaced with those granted by your new patron, subject to the GM's approval.
- Channel Divinity is considered a permanent **Divine Patron Connection**.

### Lore

Those who achieve this level of communion are recognised as trusted servants of their deity. The bond between patron and Cleric has grown beyond simple faith, becoming a lasting spiritual covenant that shapes the Cleric's every action. Many temples regard this stage as the beginning of true divine service, where miracles are no longer isolated gifts but natural expressions of the patron's presence.

Experienced Clerics often describe this connection differently. Some hear their patron's guidance as quiet whispers, while others experience vivid dreams, visions or fleeting sensations that direct their path. Regardless of how the bond manifests, all agree that the relationship becomes increasingly personal as their devotion strengthens.

The faithful believe that every act performed through Channel Divinity carries a fragment of the patron's own purpose. It is this shared purpose that separates an ordinary priest from a true Cleric, for their power is no longer borrowed—it is willingly entrusted to them.

> *"Faith opens the door. Trust invites the divine to remain."*
>
> — Archbishop Elion, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant

## Rank 3
### Description

Your soul has become a trusted vessel for your patron's divine essence. The bond between deity and Cleric is no longer one of simple devotion, but one of enduring partnership. Through this connection, your patron entrusts you with greater manifestations of their divine will, allowing their influence to shape your miracles, blessings and sacred authority.

As your understanding of your patron's teachings deepens, so too does the strength of your Channel Divinity. Every prayer carries greater purpose, every blessing reflects more of your deity's nature, and every miracle serves as a reminder that the gods continue to guide the world through their faithful servants.

While every Cleric advances through the same stages of spiritual growth, the path each follows remains unique. No two patrons grant identical gifts, ensuring that every expression of Channel Divinity reflects the ideals, domains and personality of the deity who bestowed it.

### Effects

- Channel Divinity remains a **passive talent**.
- You gain access to the **Rank III Channel Divinity effects** listed on your chosen patron's page.
- You retain all benefits gained from **Channel Divinity – Ranks I and II**.
- Channel Divinity has no universal mechanical effects of its own.
- All effects, triggers, bonuses, penalties and restrictions are determined entirely by your chosen patron.
- Patron effects may interact with your **Blessing Aura**, Cleric talents, spells and other divine abilities whenever specified on the patron's page.
- You cannot benefit from Channel Divinity effects granted by more than one patron at a time.
- If your patron changes, all previous Channel Divinity effects are lost and replaced by those granted by your new patron, subject to the GM's approval.
- Channel Divinity is considered a permanent **Divine Patron Connection**.

### Lore

To reach this level of communion is considered a rare honour among the clergy of Asteria. Senior priests often recognise these individuals not by the miracles they perform, but by the quiet confidence and unwavering faith that surrounds them. Their patron's presence has become a constant companion, guiding their actions and strengthening their resolve in times of doubt.

Ancient texts describe this stage as the beginning of true divine stewardship. The Cleric no longer simply receives blessings—they become an instrument through which their patron's purpose is fulfilled. Each act of compassion, judgement or sacrifice echoes the teachings of the deity they serve, reinforcing the sacred covenant between mortal and divine.

Many faiths believe that only those who remain steadfast in both belief and action are entrusted with such responsibility. To betray a patron's ideals is to risk weakening the very bond that grants these sacred gifts.

> *"Power is not the reward of faith. It is the responsibility entrusted to those who never abandon it."*
>
> — Saint Veridan, Keeper of the Divine Covenant

## Rank 4
### Description

Your connection to your patron has become unshakable, allowing an even greater measure of divine power to flow through your soul. The bond between deity and servant is no longer simply recognised by the faithful—it is undeniable. Your presence alone reflects your patron's authority, and every miracle you perform carries the unmistakable signature of the divine being you serve.

As your spiritual journey continues, your patron entrusts you with deeper mysteries and greater responsibilities. The blessings they bestow become more profound, while their expectations of your faith and devotion grow equally demanding. Every decision you make reflects upon your patron, strengthening the sacred covenant that binds you together.

To those who witness your miracles, it becomes clear that your power is not your own. You are an extension of your patron's will, carrying their influence wherever your journey leads and serving as a living testament to the strength of your faith.

### Effects

- Channel Divinity remains a **passive talent**.
- You gain access to the **Rank IV Channel Divinity effects** listed on your chosen patron's page.
- You retain all benefits gained from **Channel Divinity – Ranks I, II and III**.
- Channel Divinity has no universal mechanical effects of its own.
- All effects, triggers, bonuses, penalties and restrictions are determined entirely by your chosen patron.
- Patron effects may interact with your **Blessing Aura**, Cleric talents, spells and other divine abilities whenever specified on the patron's page.
- You cannot benefit from Channel Divinity effects granted by more than one patron at a time.
- If your patron changes, all previous Channel Divinity effects are removed and replaced with those granted by your new patron, subject to the GM's approval.
- Channel Divinity is considered a permanent **Divine Patron Connection**.

### Lore

Within the grand temples of Asteria, Clerics who attain this level of communion are often regarded as among their patron's greatest mortal representatives. Their unwavering devotion has forged a bond so strong that many believe the deity actively watches over them, guiding their words and deeds in subtle but meaningful ways.

The scriptures of many faiths describe these individuals as "Living Vessels," not because they contain the full power of a god, but because they have proven worthy of carrying a greater fragment of divine purpose than most mortals could endure. Their lives become inseparable from the teachings of their patron, inspiring followers and reminding the world that the gods continue to shape history through those who remain faithful.

Such responsibility is never taken lightly. The stronger the bond becomes, the greater the expectation that the Cleric will uphold the ideals of their patron, for every miracle reflects not only upon the servant, but upon the deity who granted it.

> *"The faithful seek the gods through prayer. The gods answer through those they trust."*
>
> — High Hierophant Lucian, Voice of the Celestial Synod
```

## Rank 5
### Description

Your communion with your patron has reached its highest mortal expression. The divine bond that began as an act of faith has become an unbreakable covenant, allowing your patron's influence to flow through you with unparalleled clarity. You no longer simply receive divine gifts—you have become one of your deity's most trusted representatives within the mortal world.

Every blessing you bestow, every miracle you witness and every sacred rite you perform carries the unmistakable mark of your patron. Their teachings have become inseparable from your own actions, and your unwavering devotion has earned you access to the greatest manifestations of their divine power.

Although every Cleric reaches this pinnacle through the same path of faith, no two Channel Divinities are ever alike. Each patron grants different gifts, responsibilities and expectations, ensuring that every master Cleric reflects the unique ideals and purpose of the deity they faithfully serve.

### Effects

- Channel Divinity remains a **passive talent**.
- You gain access to the **Rank V Channel Divinity effects** listed on your chosen patron's page.
- You retain all benefits gained from **Channel Divinity – Ranks I–IV**.
- Channel Divinity has no universal mechanical effects of its own.
- All effects, bonuses, penalties, triggers and restrictions are determined entirely by your chosen patron.
- Patron effects may interact with your **Blessing Aura**, Cleric talents, spells, miracles and other divine abilities whenever specified on the patron's page.
- You cannot benefit from Channel Divinity effects granted by more than one patron at a time.
- If your patron changes, all previous Channel Divinity effects are lost and replaced by those of your new patron, subject to the GM's approval.
- Channel Divinity is considered a permanent **Divine Patron Connection**.

### Lore

The highest-ranking Clerics are remembered throughout history not because of the miracles they performed, but because of the unwavering bond they shared with their patron. Their presence alone is said to inspire faith, command reverence and remind those around them that the gods remain active within the world of Asteria.

Many sacred texts describe these individuals as the "Chosen Hands" of their deity. While they never possess a god's true power, they are entrusted with carrying their patron's will further than any ordinary servant could. Their lives become examples for future generations, shaping religions, guiding kingdoms and preserving the teachings of their faith long after their mortal journey has ended.

To achieve this level of communion is both an honour and a burden. The patron's greatest gifts are reserved for those whose devotion has never faltered, for divine power without unwavering faith is a trust that can never truly be earned.

> *"The gods do not seek perfect servants. They seek faithful hearts through which their will may endure."*
>
> — Saint Elyndor, First Voice of the Divine Covenant

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

# Divine Grace

## Overview
Through unwavering faith and devoted service, your patron bestows upon you their first true blessing. This Divine Grace is not a spell nor a miracle that can be learned through study, but a sacred gift granted only to those who have proven themselves worthy in the eyes of their deity.

Every patron expresses their grace differently. A god of life may grant restorative blessings, while a god of war may instill unyielding courage. Patrons of knowledge, nature, death or countless other domains each bestow gifts that embody their own divine purpose. Though the blessing itself varies, its source remains the same—a bond of trust between deity and disciple.

As your connection deepens, your patron will reveal greater aspects of their Divine Grace, allowing these blessings to grow in strength alongside your faith. The nature of these gifts is recorded within your Patron page, making every Cleric's journey unique to the deity they serve.

## Rank 1
### Description

Through unwavering faith and devoted service, your patron bestows upon you their first true blessing. This Divine Grace is not a spell nor a miracle that can be learned through study, but a sacred gift granted only to those who have proven themselves worthy in the eyes of their deity.

Every patron expresses their grace differently. A god of life may grant restorative blessings, while a god of war may instill unyielding courage. Patrons of knowledge, nature, death or countless other domains each bestow gifts that embody their own divine purpose. Though the blessing itself varies, its source remains the same—a bond of trust between deity and disciple.

As your connection deepens, your patron will reveal greater aspects of their Divine Grace, allowing these blessings to grow in strength alongside your faith. The nature of these gifts is recorded within your Patron page, making every Cleric's journey unique to the deity they serve.

### Effects

- Divine Grace is a **Passive Talent**.
- Unlock **Divine Grace I** on your chosen Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Grace are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Grace may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- A Cleric may only benefit from the Divine Grace of one Patron at a time.
- If your Patron changes, all Divine Grace effects are replaced by those of your new Patron.

### Lore

The oldest scriptures teach that every true servant eventually receives a sign that their devotion has been acknowledged. Some describe a comforting warmth during prayer, others hear a quiet whisper carried upon the wind, while a few experience visions that forever change the course of their lives.

These moments are known collectively as Divine Grace. Though the form differs between faiths, each blessing serves as undeniable proof that a patron has accepted a follower into their service. From that moment onward, the Cleric walks not only by faith, but with the knowledge that their patron watches over their path.

The faithful often say that miracles may inspire belief, but Divine Grace is what transforms belief into an unbreakable bond between mortal and deity.

> *"Grace is not earned through strength alone—it is entrusted to those whose faith never falters."*
>
> — The Book of Divine Accord

## Rank 2
### Description

Your devotion has strengthened your bond with your patron, allowing their Divine Grace to manifest more fully within you. What was once a single blessing begins to grow into a lasting expression of your patron's divine will, shaping both your abilities and your purpose as one of their chosen servants.

Each patron grants this grace in their own way. Some offer protection to those under their care, others inspire unwavering courage, while some reveal hidden truths or command the powers of life, death, nature or countless other divine domains. Whatever form it takes, Divine Grace is a sacred reflection of the deity who bestowed it.

As your faith deepens, your patron entrusts you with greater responsibility. Their blessings become increasingly woven into your daily life, allowing your actions to better embody the ideals they represent. Every step taken in faithful service strengthens this divine connection, preparing you for the greater gifts still to come.

### Effects

- Divine Grace remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Unlock **Divine Grace II** on your chosen Patron page.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Grace effects.
- The effects of Divine Grace are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Grace may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- A Cleric may only benefit from the Divine Grace of one Patron at a time.
- If your Patron changes, all Divine Grace effects are replaced by those of your new Patron.

### Lore

Among the faithful, it is said that Divine Grace grows alongside devotion rather than appearing all at once. The first blessing is merely the beginning of a lifelong relationship between patron and Cleric, with every act of faith strengthening the sacred bond they share.

Senior priests often recognise this growth long before the Cleric does. They see subtle changes in how the faithful carry themselves, speak with conviction and perform their duties, understanding that these are outward signs of an ever-deepening divine connection. Such individuals are often entrusted with greater responsibilities, not because of their power alone, but because they have proven themselves worthy of their patron's continued favour.

Those who continue walking this path eventually become living examples of their patron's ideals, carrying a measure of divine grace wherever they travel.

> *"The first blessing is a welcome. The second is a promise that you walk the path together."*
>
> — High Priestess Elyndra, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant

## Rank 3
### Description

The bond between you and your patron has become an enduring part of your soul. Their Divine Grace is no longer an occasional blessing but a constant presence, guiding your actions and reinforcing the ideals you have sworn to uphold. Through unwavering faith, you have earned a greater measure of your patron's trust, allowing their influence to manifest more profoundly.

Although every patron grants different blessings, each Divine Grace serves the same purpose—to prepare their chosen servant for greater responsibilities. Whether your deity embodies life, war, nature, knowledge, death or another divine domain, their grace shapes you into a more faithful representative of their will.

Those who witness your deeds begin to recognise the subtle signs of your patron's favour. Your words carry greater conviction, your resolve inspires confidence, and your actions increasingly reflect the divine principles you have devoted your life to serving. While your greatest blessings still lie ahead, there is no doubt that your patron walks beside you.

### Effects

- Divine Grace remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Unlock **Divine Grace III** on your chosen Patron page.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Grace effects.
- The effects of Divine Grace are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Grace may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- A Cleric may only benefit from the Divine Grace of one Patron at a time.
- If your Patron changes, all Divine Grace effects are replaced by those of your new Patron.

### Lore

Within every major faith across Asteria, reaching the third stage of Divine Grace is regarded as a defining milestone in a Cleric's journey. It marks the point where faith is no longer sustained by belief alone, but by a living relationship between deity and disciple. Such Clerics often become mentors, temple guardians or spiritual leaders, trusted to guide others through both triumph and hardship.

Ancient chronicles speak of champions whose Divine Grace became so evident that strangers could sense their patron's presence without a single miracle being performed. Whether comforting the fearful, standing firm against impossible odds or offering wisdom during times of uncertainty, these faithful servants became living reflections of the divine ideals they represented.

It is said that while miracles reveal a patron's power, Divine Grace reveals their trust.

> *"Power may be granted in an instant, but grace is entrusted only to those who prove worthy of carrying it."*
>
> — Archon Seraphel, Voice of the Seven Temples

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron's Divine Grace has become deeply intertwined with your soul, marking you as one of their most trusted servants. Their presence is no longer something you merely call upon—it accompanies you in every prayer, every act of devotion and every decision made in their name. Your faith has matured into a sacred covenant, allowing your patron to reveal greater aspects of their divine blessing.

Each deity bestows this grace according to their own divine purpose. Whether granting unwavering courage, profound wisdom, restorative power, mastery over nature or blessings beyond mortal understanding, every expression of Divine Grace reflects the ideals of the patron who grants it. Though the blessings differ, they all serve to prepare the Cleric for the greater responsibilities that accompany unwavering faith.

Those who stand beside you begin to recognise that your patron's favour extends beyond miraculous acts alone. Your very presence reflects the values of the deity you serve, inspiring allies, strengthening the faithful and reminding others that true devotion is rewarded with blessings that cannot be earned through mortal effort alone.

### Effects

- Divine Grace remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Unlock **Divine Grace IV** on your chosen Patron page.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Grace effects.
- The effects of Divine Grace are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Grace may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- A Cleric may only benefit from the Divine Grace of one Patron at a time.
- If your Patron changes, all Divine Grace effects are replaced by those of your new Patron.

### Lore

Among the greatest temples of Asteria, only a select few Clerics are recognised as having reached this level of Divine Grace. These individuals are often entrusted with safeguarding sacred relics, leading pilgrimages across dangerous lands and acting as the living representatives of their patron's will.

Many ancient texts describe Divine Grace as a river that flows from the divine into the mortal soul. With each act of faithful service, that river grows stronger, carrying greater blessings and deeper understanding. By the fourth stage, the connection has become unmistakable, and even those outside the faith often sense the quiet authority carried by such devoted servants.

To many believers, these Clerics stand as proof that the gods do not merely watch from afar—they continue to shape the world through those who dedicate their lives to carrying their grace.

> *"The faithful do not seek greatness. They seek only to serve, and greatness follows in the footsteps of grace."*
>
> — High Oracle Caelith, Keeper of the Divine Covenant

## Rank 5
### Description

Your Divine Grace has reached its fullest expression, marking you as one of your patron's greatest mortal champions. The sacred bond between deity and disciple has become absolute, allowing your patron's blessings to flow through you with unparalleled clarity. Their will is reflected not only through your miracles, but through your words, your actions and the unwavering faith that defines your every step.

No two manifestations of Divine Grace are alike. Every patron grants blessings that embody their own divine nature, ensuring that each Cleric's journey remains unique. Whether your patron embodies life, war, knowledge, nature, death or another sacred domain, their ultimate grace transforms you into a living testament of their ideals.

The faithful look upon you as proof that unwavering devotion is rewarded. Your presence inspires hope, courage or reverence according to the nature of your patron, while those who oppose your deity cannot deny that a higher power walks beside you. Though you remain mortal, your Divine Grace has become an enduring symbol of the covenant between yourself and the god you serve.

### Effects

- Divine Grace remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Unlock **Divine Grace V** on your chosen Patron page.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Grace effects.
- The effects of Divine Grace are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Grace may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- A Cleric may only benefit from the Divine Grace of one Patron at a time.
- If your Patron changes, all Divine Grace effects are replaced by those of your new Patron.
- You have mastered your Patron's Divine Grace.

### Lore

Legends speak of only a handful of Clerics throughout history who have attained the highest expression of Divine Grace. These individuals became inseparable from the faith they served, their names remembered not for the miracles they performed, but for the unwavering devotion with which they carried their patron's will into the world.

Many founded great temples, ended holy wars, restored kingdoms or stood against ancient evils that threatened all of Asteria. Yet when asked about their accomplishments, they rarely spoke of themselves. Instead, they credited every victory, every miracle and every act of mercy to the grace bestowed upon them by their patron.

The greatest lesson passed down through these stories is that Divine Grace is never a reward for seeking power. It is the natural result of a lifetime spent in faithful service. Those who bear the Fifth Grace understand that they are not the source of the divine—they are its chosen vessel, carrying their patron's light, shadow or purpose into a world that will always need it.

> *"Grace is the quiet promise that no faithful soul ever walks alone."*
>
> — **The Book of Divine Accord**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.title: Fortified Mind
entries.body:
# Fortified Mind

## Overview
Through disciplined prayer, meditation and unwavering devotion to your patron, your mind becomes increasingly resilient against supernatural influence. While others may falter before overwhelming terror or malicious psychic forces, your faith provides an anchor that steadies your thoughts and strengthens your resolve.

Fortified Mind does not make you fearless, nor does it render your thoughts beyond reach. Instead, it reinforces your will, allowing you to recognise and resist attempts to overwhelm, manipulate or corrupt your mind. Every trial endured strengthens your confidence that your patron walks beside you, even in moments of doubt.

This mental discipline is considered a fundamental lesson among Clerics. Before they are entrusted with powerful miracles, they must first learn to protect the sanctuary of their own mind, ensuring that fear and deception cannot easily turn them from their sacred path.

## Rank 1
### Description

Through disciplined prayer, meditation and unwavering devotion to your patron, your mind becomes increasingly resilient against supernatural influence. While others may falter before overwhelming terror or malicious psychic forces, your faith provides an anchor that steadies your thoughts and strengthens your resolve.

Fortified Mind does not make you fearless, nor does it render your thoughts beyond reach. Instead, it reinforces your will, allowing you to recognise and resist attempts to overwhelm, manipulate or corrupt your mind. Every trial endured strengthens your confidence that your patron walks beside you, even in moments of doubt.

This mental discipline is considered a fundamental lesson among Clerics. Before they are entrusted with powerful miracles, they must first learn to protect the sanctuary of their own mind, ensuring that fear and deception cannot easily turn them from their sacred path.

### Effects

- Fortified Mind is a **Passive Talent**.
- Gain a **+2 bonus** to all saving throws made to resist the **Fear** condition.
- Gain a **+2 bonus** to all saving throws against **Psychic** spells, abilities and magical effects.
- Gain a **+2 bonus** to checks made to resist magical mental influence, including **Charm**, **Compulsion**, **Confusion**, **Possession**, or similar effects, as determined by the GM.
- This talent does not grant immunity to Fear, Psychic damage or mental conditions.
- Fortified Mind is considered a **Divine Blessing**.

### Lore

The greatest battles fought by a Cleric are not always against monsters or heretics, but within their own heart and mind. Ancient temples teach that faith without conviction is easily shaken, and that a mind left undefended becomes an easy target for those who wield fear and deception as weapons.

Every ordained Cleric spends countless hours studying sacred teachings while enduring spiritual trials designed to strengthen their resolve. These rituals teach them to remain calm in the face of terror, reject whispers of corruption and hold fast to the ideals of their patron, no matter how overwhelming the darkness before them may seem.

Those who master these teachings become renowned for their unwavering composure, standing firm where others would flee and meeting even the most horrifying supernatural threats with steadfast faith.

> *"The strongest fortress ever built is the mind that refuses to abandon its faith."*
>
> — High Inquisitor Seraphis

## Rank 2
### Description

Your unwavering devotion continues to strengthen your mind, forging a will that is increasingly difficult to break. The teachings of your patron have become second nature, allowing you to confront supernatural terror and psychic assaults with calm determination rather than panic.

As your faith deepens, your thoughts become more disciplined and resistant to outside influence. Malevolent entities find it harder to cloud your judgement, while fear loses much of its power over your actions. Though your mind remains mortal, it has become a sanctuary reinforced by conviction, prayer and divine purpose.

This growing resilience is recognised throughout the temples of Asteria as a sign of spiritual maturity. Experienced Clerics are expected to remain composed during moments of despair, inspiring allies through their unwavering resolve while resisting forces that seek to corrupt or dominate their minds.

### Effects

- Fortified Mind remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Gain a **+3 bonus** to all saving throws made to resist the **Fear** condition.
- Gain a **+3 bonus** to all saving throws against **Psychic** spells, abilities and magical effects.
- Gain a **+3 bonus** to checks made to resist magical mental influence, including **Charm**, **Compulsion**, **Confusion**, **Possession**, or similar effects, as determined by the GM.
- This talent does not grant immunity to Fear, Psychic damage or mental conditions.
- Fortified Mind is considered a **Divine Blessing**.

### Lore

Among the faithful, a disciplined mind is considered one of the greatest gifts a patron can nurture within their followers. Veteran Clerics often endure long periods of meditation, isolation and spiritual reflection, strengthening their resolve before they are entrusted with greater divine responsibilities.

Stories tell of Clerics who stood before nightmarish creatures without yielding, their prayers silencing the fear that consumed those around them. Others resisted the whispers of ancient horrors that sought to twist their thoughts, emerging with their faith stronger than before.

These tales remind every initiate that true strength begins within. Divine miracles may protect the body, but only unwavering conviction can protect the soul from those who seek to claim it.

> *"The darkness first conquers the mind. Guard it well, and the rest will follow."*
>
> — Sister Elyra, Keeper of the Sacred Mind

## Rank 3
### Description

Your faith has become an unshakable pillar within your soul, reinforcing your thoughts against even the most insidious supernatural influences. Fear no longer clouds your judgement as easily, and psychic assaults struggle to find weakness within a mind strengthened through years of devotion and spiritual discipline.

Rather than resisting through sheer will alone, your patron's teachings have become woven into your very nature. Every prayer remembered, every trial overcome and every act of faith has reinforced the sanctuary of your mind. While no mortal is beyond temptation or manipulation, your conviction allows you to confront such threats with remarkable clarity and determination.

Among experienced Clerics, Fortified Mind is seen as more than resilience—it is a reflection of complete trust in one's patron. Even when confronted by horrors beyond mortal understanding, the faithful remain steadfast, knowing that courage born of faith is stronger than fear born of darkness.

### Effects

- Fortified Mind remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Gain a **+4 bonus** to all saving throws made to resist the **Fear** condition.
- Gain a **+4 bonus** to all saving throws against **Psychic** spells, abilities and magical effects.
- Gain a **+4 bonus** to checks made to resist magical mental influence, including **Charm**, **Compulsion**, **Confusion**, **Possession**, or similar effects, as determined by the GM.
- This talent does not grant immunity to Fear, Psychic damage or mental conditions.
- Fortified Mind is considered a **Divine Blessing**.

### Lore

By this stage of their training, a Cleric's resolve has become well known among the faithful. Many are entrusted with guiding pilgrims through cursed lands, confronting creatures that feed upon terror or investigating places where madness has claimed countless lives. Their unwavering composure serves as a beacon of hope to those who travel beside them.

Ancient scriptures often describe the mind as the first battlefield upon which darkness wages war. Those who cannot defend their thoughts are easily led astray, while those whose faith remains unwavering become impossible to sway through fear alone. It is for this reason that senior members of every major faith continue to refine their mental discipline throughout their lives, believing that true devotion is measured not only by miracles performed, but by the strength of spirit shown in the face of despair.

> *"When fear knocks upon the mind, let faith be the hand that bars the door."*
>
> — High Cleric Thalorien, Keeper of the Sacred Scriptures

## Rank 4
### Description

Your mind has become a sanctuary of unwavering faith, forged through countless trials and strengthened by your patron's guidance. Supernatural terror, psychic intrusion and attempts to bend your will now struggle to find purchase against a spirit tempered by devotion and absolute conviction.

Every lesson learned and every hardship overcome has reinforced the barriers protecting your thoughts. Rather than relying solely upon determination, your faith has become instinctive, allowing you to remain calm and focused even when confronted by unimaginable horrors or malicious entities seeking to dominate your mind.

Senior Clerics are often entrusted with confronting cursed relics, eldritch beings and other manifestations capable of breaking the resolve of ordinary mortals. Their composure is not born from fearlessness, but from complete trust that their patron will guide them through even the darkest moments.

### Effects

- Fortified Mind remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Gain a **+5 bonus** to all saving throws made to resist the **Fear** condition.
- Gain a **+5 bonus** to all saving throws against **Psychic** spells, abilities and magical effects.
- Gain a **+5 bonus** to checks made to resist magical mental influence, including **Charm**, **Compulsion**, **Confusion**, **Possession**, or similar effects, as determined by the GM.
- This talent does not grant immunity to Fear, Psychic damage or mental conditions.
- Fortified Mind is considered a **Divine Blessing**.

### Lore

Within the greatest temples of Asteria, those who achieve this level of mental discipline are regarded as pillars of faith. Their unwavering resolve allows them to stand before horrors that would shatter lesser minds, offering guidance and reassurance when others falter beneath impossible pressure.

Many sacred texts describe the mind as the final sanctuary of the soul. While armour protects the body and miracles preserve life, only steadfast conviction can defend against corruption that begins within one's own thoughts. Clerics who master this teaching become living examples of their patron's strength, inspiring allies simply through their calm presence during moments of overwhelming despair.

To witness such unwavering resolve is often enough to rekindle hope in those who have begun to lose it, proving that faith can endure even where darkness seems absolute.

> *"A faithful heart may tremble, but a faithful mind will never yield."*
>
> — Grand Hierophant Altherion, Guardian of the Eternal Sanctum

## Rank 5
### Description

Your mind has become a bastion of unwavering conviction, strengthened by years of devotion and an unbreakable bond with your patron. Fear no longer clouds your judgement as it once did, and even the most insidious psychic assaults struggle to overcome a spirit forged through discipline, prayer and absolute faith.

Every lesson, trial and hardship has reinforced the sanctuary of your thoughts. Rather than resisting through determination alone, your faith has become an inseparable part of who you are. Attempts to manipulate, terrify or corrupt your mind are met by a will tempered through countless acts of devotion, allowing you to remain composed when others succumb to panic or despair.

Although no mortal is beyond the reach of the supernatural, few possess the mental resilience of a master Cleric. Your patron's teachings guide your thoughts, your conviction steadies your heart, and your faith serves as a constant reminder that even in the darkest moments, you are never truly alone.

### Effects

- Fortified Mind remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Gain a **+6 bonus** to all saving throws made to resist the **Fear** condition.
- Gain a **+6 bonus** to all saving throws against **Psychic** spells, abilities and magical effects.
- Gain a **+6 bonus** to checks made to resist magical mental influence, including **Charm**, **Compulsion**, **Confusion**, **Possession**, or similar effects, as determined by the GM.
- This talent does not grant immunity to Fear, Psychic damage or mental conditions.
- Fortified Mind is considered a **Divine Blessing**.

### Lore

Across Asteria, only the most devoted Clerics achieve this level of mental discipline. Their unwavering resolve has become legendary, allowing them to confront ancient evils, cursed relics and eldritch horrors without surrendering to fear or madness. While others see only terror, these faithful servants see another opportunity to place their trust in their patron.

The greatest temples often appoint such individuals to lead pilgrimages into dangerous lands, investigate supernatural disturbances and safeguard sacred relics from those who would misuse them. Their calm presence inspires confidence among allies, while their refusal to yield serves as a testament to the enduring strength of true faith.

Masters of Fortified Mind understand that courage is not the absence of fear, but the determination to stand firm despite it. Their patron's guidance has become a permanent foundation upon which every thought and every decision is built, creating a spirit that remains steadfast even when surrounded by overwhelming darkness.

> *"A mind devoted to faith cannot be conquered by fear—it can only be tested."*
>
> — Saint Aurelian, Guardian of the Eternal Mind

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.title: Mana Well
entries.body:
# Mana Well

## Overview
Before a Spellblade can master arcane combat, they must first master the vessel that contains their power. Through relentless training, meditation, and repeated exposure to mana, the Spellblade learns to expand the natural limits of their internal mana reserves.

This expansion creates the foundation of what Spellblades call a Mana Well—a deep reservoir of magical energy that fuels both their martial techniques and arcane abilities. While many novice practitioners focus on increasing their offensive power, experienced Spellblades understand that sustained combat is won by those who can continue fighting long after others have exhausted their resources.

At Rank 1, the Mana Well begins to take shape. The increase is immediately noticeable, allowing the Spellblade to cast additional abilities, maintain magical techniques for longer periods, and remain effective during extended encounters.

Though only the beginning of the talent's growth, many masters consider Mana Well one of the most important foundations of the entire Spellblade path. A deeper well creates opportunities, endurance, and flexibility that cannot be replicated through skill alone.

## Rank 1
### Description

Before a Spellblade can master arcane combat, they must first master the vessel that contains their power. Through relentless training, meditation, and repeated exposure to mana, the Spellblade learns to expand the natural limits of their internal mana reserves.

This expansion creates the foundation of what Spellblades call a Mana Well—a deep reservoir of magical energy that fuels both their martial techniques and arcane abilities. While many novice practitioners focus on increasing their offensive power, experienced Spellblades understand that sustained combat is won by those who can continue fighting long after others have exhausted their resources.

At Rank 1, the Mana Well begins to take shape. The increase is immediately noticeable, allowing the Spellblade to cast additional abilities, maintain magical techniques for longer periods, and remain effective during extended encounters.

Though only the beginning of the talent's growth, many masters consider Mana Well one of the most important foundations of the entire Spellblade path. A deeper well creates opportunities, endurance, and flexibility that cannot be replicated through skill alone.

### Effects

- Increase your **Maximum Mana by ×3**.
- This multiplier is applied to your **Base Maximum Mana**.
- The increase is permanent while this talent is learned.
- The additional mana becomes immediately available upon learning the talent.

#### Formula

Maximum Mana = Base Mana × 3

### Lore

Among Spellblades, the cultivation of a Mana Well is considered the first true milestone on the path toward mastery. While a sword may be sharpened and spells may be memorised, neither can compensate for a lack of magical endurance.

The oldest Spellblade academies teach that mana is like water carried into a vast desert. Every technique draws from the same reserve, and once that reserve is exhausted, even the greatest warrior becomes vulnerable.

Many legendary Spellblades became famous not because they possessed the most destructive abilities, but because they could continue fighting long after their opponents had depleted their strength. Their Mana Wells sustained them through battles that would have broken lesser combatants.

For this reason, instructors often insist that apprentices strengthen their reserves before pursuing more advanced techniques. A strong foundation supports every future achievement.

> "Power is meaningless when the well runs dry."
>
> — Master Valen Arcturus, Seventh Blade of the Azure Order

## Rank 2
### Description

As the Spellblade's mastery grows, so too does the depth of their Mana Well. What was once a modest reservoir begins to expand into a substantial source of arcane power, capable of sustaining increasingly demanding techniques.

The cultivation of a Mana Well is not simply a matter of storing more mana. The Spellblade learns to strengthen the pathways through which mana flows, reinforcing their body and soul so they can safely contain greater quantities of magical energy. Without this growth, advanced techniques would place unbearable strain upon the practitioner.

At Rank 2, the Spellblade experiences a significant increase in their available reserves. Battles that once required careful conservation of mana become easier to manage, allowing the Spellblade to maintain pressure and continue casting throughout longer encounters.

Many instructors consider this the point where an apprentice begins to transition into a true Spellblade. Their reserves become large enough to support both martial combat and arcane techniques without constantly risking exhaustion.

### Effects
- Increase your **Maximum Mana by ×6**.
- This multiplier is applied to your **Base Maximum Mana**.
- The additional mana becomes immediately available upon learning the talent.

#### Formula

Maximum Mana = Base Mana × 6

### Lore

Veteran Spellblades often describe Rank 2 as the point where the Mana Well becomes impossible to ignore. The increase in magical endurance is substantial enough that even inexperienced practitioners immediately notice the difference.

The process is neither comfortable nor quick. Expanding one's Mana Well requires months of disciplined training, repeated mana circulation exercises, and careful refinement of the soul's connection to arcane energy. Many students abandon the process due to its difficulty.

Those who persevere are rewarded with reserves that can sustain far more demanding techniques. This increase allows them to remain active during prolonged battles, maintaining the balance between swordsmanship and spellcraft that defines the Spellblade path.

The ancient records of the Azure Orders speak of Mana Wells as living reservoirs. The deeper they become, the more power they can hold, and the greater the possibilities available to the one who wields them.

> "The first well grants endurance. The second grants freedom."
>
> — Grand Spellblade Aethon Vale, Master of the Sapphire Hall

## Rank 3
### Description

The Mana Well has grown beyond a simple reservoir and now resembles a vast internal lake of arcane power. The Spellblade's body and soul have adapted to contain quantities of mana that would overwhelm most practitioners, allowing them to wield magic with far greater freedom.

At this stage, mana conservation becomes less about necessity and more about efficiency. The Spellblade can maintain prolonged combat techniques, sustain enchantments for longer periods, and continue casting long after others would be forced to retreat and recover.

The cultivation of such a Mana Well requires extraordinary discipline. Every increase places additional strain upon the pathways that carry mana throughout the body. Those who fail to strengthen themselves alongside their reserves risk injury, magical exhaustion, or complete mana collapse.

For many Spellblades, Rank 3 marks the point where they truly begin to feel the potential of their path. Their magical endurance becomes a defining advantage, allowing them to fight longer, cast more frequently, and adapt to changing battlefield conditions without fear of immediate depletion.

### Effects

- Increase your **Maximum Mana by ×9**.
- This multiplier is applied to your **Base Maximum Mana**.
- The additional mana becomes immediately available upon learning the talent.

#### Formula

Maximum Mana = Base Mana × 9

### Lore

Ancient Spellblade texts often describe Rank 3 as the threshold between the ordinary and the exceptional. While many warriors learn to wield magic and many mages learn to fight, few possess the reserves necessary to excel at both simultaneously.

Within the halls of the oldest arcane academies, students reaching this stage were once required to undertake endurance trials designed to test the limits of their Mana Wells. Some would cast continuously for hours, while others maintained complex enchantments throughout entire days.

Stories tell of legendary Spellblades whose Mana Wells became so deep that they could sustain magical warfare across entire campaigns. Though Rank 3 falls far short of such legends, it is often the first glimpse of what might one day become possible.

The deeper the well becomes, the more responsibility it demands. Power without discipline is dangerous, and a vast reservoir can be just as destructive to its wielder as it is to their enemies.

> "A pond may sustain a traveler. A lake may sustain a kingdom."
>
> — Archblade Seraph Valorian, Keeper of the Third Wellv

## Rank 4
### Description

Few Spellblades ever reach this stage.

The Mana Well has expanded into a vast reservoir capable of holding immense quantities of arcane energy. What once required careful conservation can now be sustained through entire battles, campaigns, and prolonged magical engagements.

At Rank 4, the Spellblade's connection to mana becomes second nature. The constant awareness of dwindling reserves fades into the background, replaced by confidence in the strength of their foundation. They possess enough energy to support advanced combat techniques while still maintaining reserves for unexpected threats.

The cultivation required to reach this level is immense. The body, mind, and soul must all be strengthened to withstand the pressure of such a large concentration of mana. Without discipline and training, the strain alone would be enough to cripple lesser practitioners.

Among the Spellblade Orders, Rank 4 is often viewed as the mark of a veteran. It is proof that the practitioner has survived years of training, battle, and refinement, building a Mana Well capable of supporting truly exceptional feats.

### Effects

- Increase your **Maximum Mana by ×12**.
- This multiplier is applied to your **Base Maximum Mana**.
- The additional mana becomes immediately available upon learning the talent.

#### Formula

Maximum Mana = Base Mana × 12

### Lore

The oldest records of the Arcane Blades speak of practitioners whose Mana Wells became so deep that they were compared to inland seas. Their reserves seemed inexhaustible to those around them, allowing them to maintain powerful techniques for astonishing lengths of time.

Within many Spellblade traditions, Rank 4 is regarded as a symbol of mastery over one's foundation. While greater power still lies ahead, few can deny the significance of reaching a stage where one's reserves dwarf those of ordinary spellcasters.

Veterans often warn younger Spellblades that a vast Mana Well is both a blessing and a burden. The temptation to rely solely upon overwhelming reserves can lead to arrogance, wastefulness, and eventual defeat.

The wisest masters understand that the purpose of a deep well is not to spend more recklessly, but to create more possibilities. The greater the reserve, the more choices remain available when others have none.

> "The difference between a novice and a master is not how much power they possess. It is how much remains when the battle is not yet over."
>
> — High Spellblade Arkanis Thorne, Warden of the Azure Depthsv

## Rank 5
### Description

The Mana Well has reached its pinnacle.

What began as a modest reservoir of arcane energy has become a vast ocean contained within the Spellblade's soul. The amount of mana available at this stage far exceeds what most practitioners will ever possess, allowing the Spellblade to sustain techniques, enchantments, and magical combat styles that would be impossible for lesser combatants.

At Rank 5, the Spellblade no longer worries about whether they possess enough mana to continue fighting. Instead, they concern themselves with how best to wield the immense reserves at their disposal. The challenge is no longer endurance, but mastery.

The cultivation required to reach this level is legendary. Every pathway within the body has been strengthened, every aspect of the soul tempered through years of training, combat, and arcane refinement. Few ever achieve such depth within their Mana Well, and those who do are often regarded as living legends among their peers.

This rank represents the culmination of the Spellblade's foundation. Every spell cast, every enchanted strike, and every future talent built upon arcane power draws strength from the immense reservoir created through Mana Well.

### Effects

- Increase your **Maximum Mana by ×15**.
- This multiplier is applied to your **Base Maximum Mana**.
- The additional mana becomes immediately available upon learning the talent.

#### Formula

Maximum Mana = Base Mana × 15

### Lore

Among the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank 5 is often called **The Endless Reservoir**. It is said that a practitioner who reaches this stage possesses enough arcane endurance to fight battles that would exhaust entire companies of lesser spellcasters.

Ancient chronicles tell of legendary Spellblades who marched for days without rest, sustaining magical wards, empowering their weapons, and continuing to cast even as entire armies exhausted their reserves. Whether these stories are entirely true or embellished through centuries of retelling remains a matter of debate.

What is certain is that those who reach Rank 5 stand among the elite of their discipline. Their Mana Wells are so deep that they cease to be measured against ordinary standards. Their reserves become a defining aspect of their identity, spoken of with the same reverence as a master swordsman's skill or an archmage's knowledge.

Yet the wisest among them know a simple truth: even an ocean can be emptied if enough is taken from it. A vast Mana Well is not permission for recklessness, but the reward for discipline. Those who remember this lesson become legends. Those who forget it become cautionary tales.

> "The purpose of a great reservoir is not to spend without thought. It is to ensure that when the final moment arrives, you still have power left to give."
>
> — Grandmaster Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
